input: Loss of human agency and autonomy is a risk associated with An automated system is designed to evaluate employee performance based on various indicators, aiming to provide a fair and efficient assessment. The system uses data-driven approaches to identify trends and patterns in performance, helping to inform decisions. It also seeks to streamline the evaluation process, minimizing the need for manual intervention.
